body:
Greets the captain and uses the crew’s numerical advantage as a threat.

Recorded role and choices

Raferty arrives during the July 2025 negotiations and argues that the adventurers survive because the pirates allow it. His offhand manner and food do not erase the coercion in that warning. Later remarks defend the crew’s actions. The selected scene establishes his participation, without making him the captain or merging him with similarly illustrated pirate proxies.
